tasks.label: geo-all-countries-write
args: import json; from extraction_pipeline.country_inputs.cli import list_geo_iso3s, run_geo_example; iso3s,_=list_geo_iso3s(); results=[run_geo_example(i,0,True) for i in iso3s]; summary={'ok': all(r.get('ok',False) for r in results), 'count': len(results), 'success': sum(1 for r in results if r.get('ok',False)), 'failed': [r for r in results if not r.get('ok',False)]}; print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

tasks.label: verify-recent-output-writes
tasks.command: $root='extraction/20_drafts/runs/country-parameters'; $cut=(Get-Date).AddMinutes(-20); $recent=Get-ChildItem $root -Recurse -File -Filter *.yaml | Where-Object { $_.LastWriteTime -gt $cut }; $geo=($recent | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'PARAM-GEO-GMD-CROSSWALK.yaml' }).Count; $edu=($recent | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'PARAM-EDU-LEVEL-CROSSWALK.yaml' }).Count; $water=($recent | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'PARAM-WASH-WATER-CROSSWALK.yaml' }).Count; $san=($recent | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'PARAM-WASH-SANITATION-CROSSWALK.yaml' }).Count; Write-Output ('RECENT_TOTAL=' + $recent.Count); Write-Output ('RECENT_GEO=' + $geo); Write-Output ('RECENT_EDU=' + $edu); Write-Output ('RECENT_WATER=' + $water); Write-Output ('RECENT_SAN=' + $san)
